items.title: Broadcast Misinformation
items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 12, slot P (New Actions, right column, third)
items.text:
BROADCAST MISINFORMATION
At a city containing a satellite tower, move a Hollow Men figure to a location adjacent to where the figure currently is. The color of your current city must match the color of the Hollow Men figure's current city.
You may not move a Hollow Men figure into a location that already contains 3 Hollow Men figures.

rules: Requires a satellite tower in your city.
Move one Hollow Men figure one step, to an adjacent location.
The color of your city must match the color of the city the figure is leaving.
The destination cannot already contain 3 Hollow Men figures.
mechanics.effect: Reposition one Hollow Men figure by one adjacent step, under a matching-color and stack-limit constraint.

summary: Action at a satellite tower: move one Hollow Men figure to an adjacent location. Your city's color must match the figure's current city, and the destination cannot already hold 3 Hollow Men.
